alignments.note: Anarthrous participle with rule 46's supplied *He that*; *hath pity* is a light verb with its complement, headed on *pity* under rule 44, and the supplied *upon* reaches its bare object under the same rule.
Substantival adjective with the supplied *the* under rule 46.
The construct relation is recast with *unto*, which belongs to the rectum under rule 19.

One substantive rendered by two words; I read *deed* as carrying the lexeme and *good* as the ASV's specifier, so the head is *deed*. The competing reading under rule 31's tie test makes *deed* the supplied generic and heads on *good*.

Finite verb with its subject pronoun and auxiliary under rule 17; *again* completes the repaying that *pay* alone does not write, so it stays with the verb under rule 44, discontinuous around the object pronoun.
Dative preposition rendered as a bare English indirect object; unrepresented under rule 40.
Suffix to the object pronoun under rules 18 and 40.

review_notes: The head of *good deed* is the one materially open choice and is recorded in its note.
